enforced_invariants: A nonzero fixed emit cost remains reserved before every selected refinement.
Fixed configured costs and every finite action value are checked before mutation, even for an infeasible candidate.
The current session, version, depth, portfolio index, and latent digest must match each decision.
A selected action is charged exactly once and blocks another choice until its execution acknowledgement.
All four text/audio/image/video output hashes are required to seal an emission.
Sealed sessions reject later actions; a new session requires a strictly increasing session ID.
Emission wins ties up to the shared 1e-12 threshold, independent of action table order.
Oversized TSV input and EOF before completed emission fail closed.

Hashes are caller-supplied integrity bindings, not cryptographic attestations that a model kernel ran.
No production NeuronModelPort/NeuronRuntime dispatch path was changed.
